# vpsie_protect_policy (Resource)

A Backup or Disaster-recovery protection policy: how often protected servers are copied (RPO), how long their recovery points are kept and how they are verified. Servers are added to a policy in the portal or through the API; a policy that still has protected servers cannot be removed. The `backup` and `dr` tiers need the matching licence module and the account's permission to create.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "vpsie_protect_policy" "nightly" {
  name        = "nightly-backup"
  tier        = "backup"
  datacenter  = "replace-with-datacenter-identifier"
  rpo_minutes = 1440

  retention = {
    keep_recent_hours = 24
    keep_daily        = 7
    keep_weekly       = 4
  }

  immutability_days = 7
  verify_mode       = "latest-weekly"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `datacenter` (String) The datacenter identifier the protection copies into. Changing it replaces the policy.
- `name` (String) The policy name. Removing the policy needs this name, so it is read from the state at destroy.
- `retention` (Attributes) How many recovery points are kept. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--retention))
- `rpo_minutes` (Number) The recovery point objective in minutes: 15, 30, 60, 120, 240, 480, 720 or 1440.
- `tier` (String) `backup` or `dr` (disaster recovery). Changing it replaces the policy.

### Optional

- `consistency` (String) `app` (application-consistent, the default) or `crash`.
- `immutability_days` (Number) Days a recovery point cannot be deleted (0 to 30). The platform default is 7.
- `plan` (String) The protection plan identifier (GUID) the policy is billed under, when the account has more than one. Changing it replaces the policy.
- `rto_target_minutes` (Number) The recovery time objective to report against, in minutes (5 to 1440). Removing it clears the target.
- `verify_mode` (String) Boot checks of recovery points: `off` (the default), `latest-daily` or `latest-weekly`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the policy was created (RFC 3339).
- `identifier` (String) The policy identifier.
- `state` (String) The policy state: `active`, `paused` or `pending_approval`.
- `version` (Number) The policy version the platform uses to refuse edits made from a stale read.

<a id="nestedatt--retention"></a>
### Nested Schema for `retention`

Required:

- `keep_daily` (Number) Daily recovery points to keep (0 to 60).
- `keep_recent_hours` (Number) Hours of every recovery point to keep (0 to 168).
- `keep_weekly` (Number) Weekly recovery points to keep (0 to 26).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A protection policy can be imported with its identifier.
terraform import vpsie_protect_policy.nightly <policy-identifier>
```
